windows.changelog:
Plume is now called Daino Notes. We rebranded as part of our vision at Daino to help people actualize their potential. At Daino, we create tools for your mind so you can turn your potential into wonderful creations.

You can explore our new website at: get-notes.com

Apart from the rebrand, this release also brings:

  • Enhanced stability
  • Reduced memory usage
  • Various bug fixes and improvements

If you're a Plume Pro subscriber, please check your email for instructions on how to activate Daino Notes Pro.

Thanks for all the community feedback! We have much more to show, so stay tuned.

Join our Discord for discussions, and feel free to email us. We love hearing from our users.
